scope.onlineStorePublication: publish newly created canonical collections to Online Store; preserve existing publication state
scope.legacyHandleRedirects: redirect only explicitly checked-in legacy handles when reusing their collection record
scope.priceCollections: repair exact variant-price conditions and verify exact live membership
